sentences.text: Craig Ashley David -LRB- born 5 May 1981 -RRB- is a British singer , songwriter , rapper and record producer who rose to fame in 1999 , featuring on the single , `` Re-Rewind '' by Artful Dodger .	Re-Rewind	Re-Rewind (The Crowd Say Bo Selecta)	Artful Dodger	Artful Dodger (UK band)

David 's debut studio album , Born to Do It , was released in 2000 , after which he has released a further five studio albums and worked with a variety of artists such as Tinchy Stryder , Kano , Jay Sean , Rita Ora , Hardwell and Sting .	Born to Do It	Born to Do It	Tinchy Stryder	Tinchy Stryder	Kano	Kano (rapper)	Jay Sean	Jay Sean	Rita Ora	Rita Ora	Hardwell	Hardwell	Sting	Sting (musician)
David has 20 UK top 40 singles , and seven UK top 40 albums , selling over 15 million records worldwide as a solo artist .

David has been nominated for thirteen Brit Awards : four times for Best British Male , and twice received a Grammy Award nomination for Best Male Pop Vocal Performance .
